instruction: I don't want websites to access my microphone. How do I block microphone access in Chrome?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking microphone access for all websites in Chrome. Similar complexity - navigate to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > Microphone and block access.
